## Core Technical Competencies
- Databases & Querying: Advanced SQL, MariaDB, OracleDB, MySQL, T-SQL, PostgreSQL. Complex multi-table joins, CTEs, Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG), Execution Plan tuning, Indexing.
- Business Intelligence & Data Modeling: Microsoft Power BI, DAX (Time Intelligence, Dynamic Ratios), Kimball Star Schema (Fact/Dimension modeling), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Executive KPI dashboards.
- Advanced Excel & Operations: XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Dynamic Arrays, Nested Logic, Power Query / M ETL, Power Pivot, Data Modeling, What-If Scenario Modeling, Sensitivity Tables.
- Data Engineering & Scripting: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch), Automated ETL pipelines, Identity Resolution algorithms, OpenXML generation, Bash scripting, Linux.
- Business Analysis & Strategy: Problem decomposition, multi-tier defaulter segmentation, Root cause analysis, Schema reconciliation with national agencies (NIC), UAT protocols.

## Flagship Enterprise & Engineering Initiatives
1. Statewide Healthcare Attendance & Payroll Intelligence (CHiPS & Dept. of Health, Govt. of Chhattisgarh):
   - Engineered automated SQL ETL pipelines joining biometric punch logs across statewide public healthcare facilities with State Treasury payroll codes, resolving employee identity mismatches across MariaDB and OracleDB.
   - Built an executive production Power BI dashboard suite featuring a multi-level drill-down hierarchy (District → Facility → Designation → Employee) and custom DAX measures.
   - Designed a multi-tier defaulter risk model to uncover bonded doctor non-compliance and prevent public fund leakage.

2. Essential Drug Multi-Criteria ABC/VED/SDE Inventory Matrix (CHiPS):
   - Classified statewide pharmaceutical catalogs using composite ABC, VED, and SDE frameworks in OracleDB and Advanced Excel.
   - Deployed interactive procurement scorecards in Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) across clinical directorates to eliminate hospital stockouts.

3. Proactive 5G mmWave Handover Prediction via Diffusion Models (M.Tech Thesis):
   - Engineered a GRU memory network with a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM/DDIM) to generate forward-looking radio telemetry degradation paths.
   - Resolved severe class imbalance via SMOTE + Tomek Links and deployed a Random Forest policy engine achieving high-precision F1-score.

4. Career-Ops Autonomous Job Acquisition Bot (Open Source):
   - Python automation pipeline featuring multi-channel ATS API discovery (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), concurrent link liveness checks, zero-dependency OpenXML spreadsheet generation, and headless Playwright auto-submission with role-matched resume routing.
